note.es: corrida 14:48 UTC = franja pre-ny, pero hoy es sabado CT y ese slot solo vigila lun-vie, asi que no habia corrida del Session Analyst que rehacer; mercado cerrado desde el cierre del viernes hasta la reapertura del domingo 17:00 CT (cierre semanal de Globex), por eso snapshot a 1053 min, fuentes/orb/command a 1067 min, webhook a 1067 min y news a 1083 min solo reflejan el cierre, no una falla (orb no frozen: fecha y PDH/PDL de los 5 simbolos coinciden con command; mismas lecturas 'stale' que en la corrida anterior de las 07:47Z, sin empeorar a dead/frozen); SA pre-asia del viernes sigue en pie (commit 'sa pre-asia 2026-10-10' a las 21:34Z, +29 min vs cron 21:05Z, ok:true); el journal digest sigue parado en 2026-10-05, ya 116 h, siguen faltando martes 10-06, miercoles 10-07, jueves 10-08 y viernes 10-09 -- unico motivo real del warn
note.en: 14:48 UTC run = the pre-ny slot, but today is Saturday CT and that slot only watches Mon-Fri, so there was no Session Analyst run to redo; market closed since Friday's close until the Sunday 17:00 CT reopen (Globex weekly close), so the 1053-min snapshot, 1067-min sources/orb/command, 1067-min webhook and 1083-min news only reflect that closure, not a failure (orb not frozen: date and PDH/PDL for all 5 symbols match command; same 'stale' readings as the prior 07:47Z check, not worsening to dead/frozen); Friday's SA pre-asia run still holds (commit 'sa pre-asia 2026-10-10' at 21:34Z, +29 min vs the 21:05Z cron, ok:true); the journal digest is still stuck at 2026-10-05, now 116 h, still missing Tuesday 10-06, Wednesday 10-07, Thursday 10-08 and Friday 10-09 -- the only real reason for the warn
